era.note: A stone ankh overgrown with flowering vines. The ankh has been the Virtues' holy symbol since Ultima IV; vines and violets are ordinary garden growth. Art is later.

implNote: plain static; the vines are part of the art; art for west and north

implNote: plain static; foliage-flagged vine art; art for west and north
